Title: [LSJ] Darkness Within move blood effect timing

Messages.Author: Daneel
Messages.Body:
Frederick the Weak has 1 blood. Opposing minion has played
Darkness Within before range, and has chosen "hands for
one" as his strike. Will Frederick's blood be moved to the
Darkness Within before the damage from the opposing minion's
hand strike is resolved, effectively resulting in (barring
effects like prevention) Frederick going into torpor?

Or can Frederick choose to resolve the damage first, using
his blood to heal it, and then sequencing the Darkness
Within effect to occur after that (which will then simply
move away 0 blood from him)?

--
Bye,

Daneel

Messages.Author: Emmit Svenson
Messages.Body:


Healing and preventing destruction happen after strikes resolve. DW
takes the opposing minion's blood before he can use it to heal himself.

Messages.Author: Dragos
Messages.Body:
Emmit Svenson escreveu:

> Healing and preventing destruction happen after strikes resolve. DW
> takes the opposing minion's blood before he can use it to heal himself.

What about the timing for playing Claws of the Dead, considering the

Dan

Messages.Author: Emmit Svenson
Messages.Body:


You must play CotD before strike resolution, so blood is spent to pay
for that card before DW steals blood.
